mapper.sql: select field_id, version_id, field_alias, field_name, source_table_id, source_column_id, data_type, expression_json, is_object_key, sensitivity_level, mask_rule, enabled, order_num from dp_dataset_field
mapper.select: select f.field_id as fieldId, f.field_alias as fieldAlias, f.field_name as fieldName, f.data_type as dataType, f.is_object_key as isObjectKey, c.is_pk as isPk, c.column_comment as columnComment, f.source_table_id as sourceTableId, f.source_column_id as sourceColumnId, t.object_name as tableName, d.datasource_id as datasourceId from dp_dataset_field f join dp_dataset_version v on v.version_id = f.version_id join dp_dataset d on d.dataset_id = v.dataset_id left join dp_meta_column c on c.column_id = f.source_column_id left join dp_meta_table t on t.table_id = f.source_table_id where f.version_id = #{versionId} and f.enabled = '1' order by f.order_num
mapper.insert:
insert into dp_dataset_field ( version_id, field_alias, field_name, source_table_id, source_column_id, data_type, enabled, order_num ) values
(#{item.versionId}, #{item.fieldAlias}, #{item.fieldName}, #{item.sourceTableId}, #{item.sourceColumnId}, #{item.dataType}, #{item.enabled}, #{item.orderNum})
